name: Swordswoman Sapphie
source:
Hero mixed with Fate/Stay Night? Nah, this isn't even my story. I merely transcribed the text from the library in Legend of Heroes: A Tear of Vermillion for the PSP. I just felt like making this VN while I was playing. It's a straight transcription, so if you think it's a touching story, congratulate the authors/translators of the first batch of Legend of Heroes games on the PSP.

[From the [url=https://rd2k2-games.blogspot.com/2011/08/swordswoman-sapphie.html]Official site[/url]]
